retainedRegionChecks.region: Left circuit, switch/contact numerals and charge shapes
Right circuit, switch/contact numerals and charge shapes
Spring/mass, reference strokes, displacement glyphs and extrema

findings: The clipped MAIN caption fragment is absent from both current images. Its complete bottom-edge exclusion is white in the PNG and in the existing SVG preview.
Two circuits still share exactly one a-shaped subdivision mark; the spring/mass keeps its separate be-shaped mark. Neither circuit was relabeled as a separate subdivision.

Both circuits retain the two-cell strokes, dashed continuation, bottom capacitor junctions, four-lobed coils, circular switch pivots and contact numerals 1/2. The left blade meets 1 with 2 open; the right blade meets 2 with 1 open.

Both capacitors retain the four upper plus shapes, four lower minus strokes, upper q-like/M-shaped charge group and lower leading-minus charge group; relative positions and polarity shapes remain unchanged.
The striped support, attachment, complete source zigzag spring and shaded mass remain. The broken equilibrium/reference line stays separate from the electrical coil; its label shape remains below it.
The lower mass-level horizontal stroke, rightward endpoint, full right vertical displacement stroke, upper/lower head-like regions, lower tail and both adjacent glyph groups remain in both images.

At the zero-padding extrema, the top contact numerals, rightmost displacement-level endpoint and bottom mechanical subdivision have not lost source pixels. There is no nonwhite source pixel outside the new rectangle in the checked drawing band.

No added connector, terminal, subdivision, graph, grid or displacement value was observed. The PNG differs from the mapped original source only by the 24 caption-fragment pixels inside the authorized exclusion.

limitations: This is only an affected-only RAW28 decision. Historical D272 records remain unchanged; this report neither rewrites that failure nor reapproves fig26/27.
Padding 0 places some original ink at canvas extrema. Source-pixel retention is verified here; aesthetic padding and downstream UI readability are not approval claims.
The existing SVG preview smooths raster edges and scan pinholes. No instructional stroke, glyph-shape, subdivision or apparatus loss was observed, but SVG pixel identity is not claimed.
Tiny charge/displacement subscripts, spring attachment-turn counts and arrowhead contours are retained as visible source shapes, not adjudicated encoded text or exact numerical displacement.
The SVG verdict uses the supplied hash-bound existing preview; no independent rerender was performed.
